name: claudeconnect
notes: The update screen can always be closed: it keeps going by itself and the button in the top bar shows how far it's got. It's one progress bar instead of a long list, it no longer pops up on its own on other pages, and "What's coming" is gone from it.
When an update brings a new setting, the update screen asks about it before you press Update now, and the answer is set as soon as the new version is running. Updating from a terminal asks too.
Everything the edit command can change is in Settings now: starting when you log in and showing your usage credit balance are under General → This computer.
Your usage credit balance shows on Plan usage by default, with your promotional credits (or that there are none right now). Turn it off in Settings → General.
Checks on new versions run in parallel, so changes reach you sooner.

questions.label: Show your usage credit balance on Plan usage?
questions.help: Your computer asks Claude for your balance, promotional credits and this month's spending, with Claude Code's sign-in. The sign-in never leaves your computer.
